method: MCP browser (navigate+snapshot at 1280px, 768px, 375px) + curl + HTML analysis
anti_duplicate_note: Previous tests covered: vendor/pricing (0445), search/category/PDP (0600), EN i18n (0630), issue #675 verification (0700), CMS tables (0715). THIS test: Exclusively focuses on HOME-to-CATEGORY funnel responsive UX — testing mega-menu, category listing sidebar collapse, and homepage hero+features section at 3 breakpoints (1280/768/375).
scenario: Home-to-Category responsive funnel — homepage hero, navbar, latest listings, categories section, and category listing page (Tornos) at desktop/tablet/mobile viewports

desktop_1280px.layout: Full 4-column grid (latest listings), horizontal navbar with text labels, 2-column hero stats, 4-column footer

tablet_768px.layout: 2-column footer, sidebar (filter panel) 240px + content 440px on category page, compacted navbar (icons+text for login/Vender), 2-column latest listings on homepage

mobile_375px.layout: Single column everywhere, icon-only navbar (search, login, sell icons), footer accordion (collapsible sections), listing cards full-width.

hero_section_375px.detail: Hero stacks vertically — tagline, CTA, stats all within 327px container (375-24-24 padding). Full-width CTA button works well.
hero_section_375px.boxes_verified: Empieza gratis CTA [24,331,327,52] — full-width button, good tap target

hero_section_1280px.detail: Full horizontal layout — text left, stats right, within 1152px max-width container

latest_listings_375px.detail: Grid collapses to single column — each listing is 343px wide (full width), image is 313px wide. Product cards stack vertically in 2-row layout (image on top, text below).
latest_listings_375px.box_verified: Articles at [16,1074,343,349] through [16,2960,343,349] — all within 375px viewport, no overflow

latest_listings_1280px.images_consistent: All product images standard 220x147px — consistent aspect ratio

category_section.mobile_375px: Single column — each link full-width 343px, category icons 32px with text right

how_it_works_section.mobile_375px: Single column — steps stack vertically, each with centered heading and text (276px wide within 311px container)
how_it_works_section.verdict: PASS — good mobile stack with consistent spacing

cta_bars.machines_counter_bar: Works at all breakpoints — text wraps at 375px (14px padding each side, 347px content area)
cta_bars.alert_bar_crear_alerta: Same responsive behavior — wraps text at mobile, CTA button below text at 375px

desktop_1280px.category_description: Rich text with 'Leer más' collapsible — good UX

mobile_375px.breadcrumb: Visible at top — good for navigation

pagination_responsive.tablet_768px: Pagination shows 1-3...27 with prev/next in a compact bar
pagination_responsive.tap_target_check: Page number buttons: 27-44px width — some below 44px WCAG minimum for touch
pagination_responsive.mobile_page_number_buttons_width: Not directly visible at 375px (pagination likely at bottom after product list)

cookie_consent.desktop: Thin bar at bottom of viewport, inline text + link + accept button
cookie_consent.mobile_375px: Full modal-style dialog covering middle of screen [0,386,375,426] — text wraps nicely, Accept button full-width [16,762,343,38]
cookie_consent.verdict: PASS — properly responsive, Accept button is full-width and large enough for touch

browser_unavailability.issue: Playwright cannot launch — remote browser at 51.254.244.216:3000 connection refused. MCP browser (pwmcp-zonacnc) worked for navigate+snapshot but click/type/evaluate unavailable.
browser_unavailability.impact: Cannot perform interactive verification (e.g., actually clicking 'Show filters' on mobile to verify sidebar opens). Visual validation done via snapshot analysis.
browser_unavailability.workaround: MCP browser navigate+snapshot successfully used for all viewport sizes

touch_target_size.detail: Navbar icons at 375px are 32x32px — below 44x44 WCAG minimum for touch targets. Affects 3-4 navbar icons.
touch_target_size.recommendation: Add min-width:44px and min-height:44px with padding to navbar icon links on mobile

summary.verdict_text: The homepage-to-category funnel shows strong responsive behavior across all 3 breakpoints tested. The layout properly collapses from 4-column grid (1280px) to single-column (375px), navigation changes from full-text to icon-only, and footer becomes accordion-style. The only notable issue is sub-44px touch targets on mobile navbar icons.
summary.unique_scenario: Homepage hero/navbar/categories + category listing page (Tornos) — 3 breakpoint analysis. Not covered in previous tests (0445=vendor, 0600=search/PDP, 0630=EN i18n, 0700=#675, 0715=CMS tables)
